opening.argument: The video promises “50$ Free Uber Rides” and directs viewers to biggamer.info/uber, an external destination presented with Uber branding without evidence of official affiliation. Access is not simply provided: the page instructs viewers to enter an email address, then requires human verification conducted through survey completion. Although the sequence displays a purported promo code and an email containing another code-like string, it does not establish that either code was authorized by Uber, redeemed, or worked within Uber’s service. The promotion therefore uses a low-barrier reward claim to direct viewers into an email and survey-based verification process, without demonstrating the advertised benefit.
